description: This file defines a 'DefaultPortManager' in Go that manages network port reservations, including finding free ports, checking port availability, and reserving or releasing ports within the application context.

classes.name: DefaultPortManager
classes.description: A struct that tracks reserved network ports internally and provides methods for port management.

methods.name: NewPortManager
methods.description: Factory function that creates and initializes a new DefaultPortManager instance.

methods.name: FindFreePort
methods.description: Finds a free network port within a specified range, checking system availability and internal reservations.

methods.name: IsPortAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific port can be listened on, indicating its availability.

methods.name: ReservePort
methods.description: Marks a port as reserved if it is available at the system level.

methods.name: ReleasePort
methods.description: Releases a previously reserved port, freeing it for future reservations.
